location.description: Root directory from which TFTP serves files. Must be accessible and readable by the daemon user.

address.description: IP address to bind the TFTP server to. Leave empty or set to '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces. Use '::' for IPv6 all.

port.description: UDP port number for TFTP traffic. Standard TFTP uses 69.

max_blocksize.description: Maximum TFTP block size in bytes. RFC 2348 allows up to 65464, but typical safe value is ~1428 for Ethernet MTU.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for TFTP operations (e.g., transfer start/end).

secure.description: Enable secure mode: chroot into `location` and drop privileges to `user`/`group`. Recommended for production.

extended.description: Enable RFC-compliant extensions: blocksize (RFC 2348), timeout (RFC 2349), and tsize (RFC 2347).

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support. If `address` is set to '::', this is implied.

legacy.description: Disable all RFC extensions and enforce strict RFC 1350 (original TFTP) mode.

user.description: User account under which the TFTP daemon runs when in secure mode.

group.description: Group account under which the TFTP daemon runs when in secure mode.

umask.description: Umask for files created during TFTP writes (e.g., '022' → 0o022 → mode 0644).

extra_options.description: Additional command-line options passed directly to the tftpd-hpa daemon (e.g., `--no-fork`, `--pidfile /run/tftpd.pid`).

services.description: List of named service instances for multi-tenant or per-path TFTP configurations.

location.description: Override root directory for this instance. Falls back to global `location` if omitted.

address.description: Override bind address for this instance. Falls back to global `address` if omitted.

port.description: Override port for this instance. Falls back to global `port` if omitted.

secure.description: Override secure mode for this instance. Falls back to global `secure` if omitted.

extra_options.description: Additional daemon options for this instance only.
